changeSet.author: amayabratcher
changeSet.comment: Remove duplicate (course_id, email) rows from COURSE_STAFF before adding the unique constraint. For each duplicate group, keep the row linked to GitHub if there is one, otherwise the oldest row. No other table references COURSE_STAFF rows.

sql.sql: DELETE FROM course_staff WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY course_id, email ORDER BY CASE WHEN github_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, id) AS rn FROM course_staff) r WHERE rn > 1)
